compartment.title: Integration Products (SDK, VS Code, A2A, DevTools)

paths.notes: no client/src dir; devtools ships pre-rendered client/index.html and inlined CLIENT_JS

evidence.claim: All four products depend on @google/gemini-cli-core: SDK and A2A as workspace file:../core, VS Code via deep subpath import, DevTools via core runtime loader.
SDK is the only product that builds a core Config + GeminiClient in-process; VS Code and A2A proxy via MCP and the @a2a-js/sdk executor contract respectively.
A2A command registry is disjoint from CLI: only extensions, restore, init, memory are registered; a CLI /pollux command does not automatically surface in A2A.
VS Code companion activates on onStartupFinished and publishes a stable contract of four commands, one custom language id, two keybindings, and one configuration property.
DevTools is loaded dynamically by the core runtime but externalized from the CLI bundle; the root bundle script orchestrates devtools build and bundle:browser-mcp core step before esbuild runs.

contradictions.description: Guideline lists packages/devtools/client/src as primary; devtools actually ships a pre-rendered client/index.html and inlined CLIENT_JS.
VS Code companion imports from @google/gemini-cli-core/src/ide/detect-ide.js (deep subpath, not package main); core refactors to src/ide/* can silently break the extension.

risks.description: VS Code companion deep-imports core src/ide/*; no contract test pins the subpath, so a core ide/ refactor during Pollux work could break the extension without CI signal.
risks.suggestedGuard: Add a typecheck-only smoke test that imports the deep subpaths used by the extension.

risks.description: A2A's CoderAgentExecutor bypasses Turn/GeminiClient.sendMessageStream; Pollux integrated at GeminiClient level silently skips A2A sessions.
risks.suggestedGuard: Pollux rollout must explicitly state 'A2A not covered in Phase 1' or add an A2A-specific interceptor.

risks.description: DevTools is loaded dynamically from the externalized package; core/devtools version skew causes runtime import failures.
risks.suggestedGuard: Lockstep version bumps are enforced by scripts/version.js; document the coupling in release notes.

risks.description: SDK resumeSession filters candidates by the first 8 chars of the session id without a collision warning when multiple match.
risks.suggestedGuard: Log a warning when the candidate set exceeds 1 for a given prefix.

observabilitySignals: debugLogger warnings on duplicate A2A command registration
gaps: No contract test for VS Code companion deep core imports (R-13.1).
No A2A test that asserts Pollux pathway is reachable or explicitly bypassed (R-13.2).

openQuestions: OQ-13.1: Does Pollux rollout scope include A2A (CoderAgentExecutor) and SDK (GeminiCliSession)? Escalate to synthesis.
OQ-13.2: Should VS Code companion surface a marker when connected to a /pollux-enabled CLI? Escalate to 05.

definitionOfDone.item: All integration products have independent architecture summaries.
Shared dependencies and coupling are mapped.
Pre-flight path validation recorded in report section 0.
Evidence matrix populated in the JSON sidecar.
